hypothesisMarkdown:
## Gradient reach sampled coarsely Hypothesis

How far a moving linear gradient's bands reach (far past the view, in the unit gradient's lengths) was sampled to single precision, though it only has to lie far out: within a thousandth of its largest value (50 of 50,000 points past the view) it keeps a fraction of the samples (`Graph::sampled_within`).\n\n**Tested mechanism:** coarse tolerance for reach. **Allowed:** `graph.rs` sampled_within, `plan/paint.rs` reach, test. **Forbidden:** other sampled values.
